$comment: Network parameters. Values are environment variable NAMES, not shell expansions --
the previous version embedded ${VAR:+...} bash syntax inside JSON, which nothing in
the repo could evaluate. Consumers read the named variable themselves; see
identity/src/config.ts and railgun-sidecar/src/config.ts for the resolution order.

bundler.$comment: Pimlico serves bundler and paymaster on the same endpoint.

railgun.$comment: From @railgun-community/shared-models NETWORK_CONFIG.EthereumSepolia. Recorded here so the sidecar can pin a scan start block instead of rescanning from genesis.

uniswapV3.$comment: Cookbook ships no working Sepolia swap adapter (its 0x v1 adapter targets the retired sepolia.api.0x.org, and its UniV2 adapters throw for Sepolia), so the sidecar builds a custom Cookbook Step against Uniswap V3, which does have real Sepolia liquidity in the 0.05% WETH/USDC pool.
